scope: Five fixed monotone mappings on six inputs at both profiles: 60 candidate depth fields, not full-corpus or rendered acceptance.
method: Gamma .75/1.25 or empirical-CDF mixes .25/.5/1 inside original raw p2/p98, preserving both tails. Both source RGB and the original finder stay fixed. Reference errors are evaluated on the transformed relative-depth data.
decision: Cut all five mappings: every variant causes flat or order-warning regressions, and each worsens at least one reference AbsRel. The largest bounded sample flat-mean reduction is 14.58% before its order and reference failures.
